headlines.description: — Giannis Antetokounmpo had 32 points, 15 assists and 11 rebounds to lead the Milwaukee Bucks in a 125-119 win over the Detroit Pistons on Friday night, securing the No. 5 seed in the Eastern Conference playoffs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Antetokounmpo's 11th triple-double lifts Bucks to 125-119 win over Pistons to secure No. 5 seed

headlines.description: — Trevelin Queen scored a career-high 25 points and Anthony Black added 21 points, six rebounds and seven assists to help the Orlando Magic pull away from the Indiana Pacers 129-115 in a battle...
headlines.shortLinkText: Trevelin Queen's big night leads Magic past Pacers 129-115 in battle of backups

headlines.description: — Trae Young hit six 3-pointers and had 36 points and 11 assists, Caris LeVert added 31 points and the Atlanta Hawks beat the Philadelphia 76ers 124-110 on Friday night, securing an Eastern Conference play-in spot.
headlines.shortLinkText: Young scores 36, LeVert adds 31 as Hawks secure play-in spot with 124-110 over 76ers

headlines.description: — Payton Pritchard scored 22 points, Sam Hauser had 20 and the Boston Celtics beat the Charlotte Hornets 130-94 on Friday night for their 60th victory of the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Celtics rout the Hornets 130-94 for their 60th victory of the season

headlines.description: — Darius Garland scored 13 of his 26 points in the fourth quarter to lead the Cleveland Cavaliers' comeback from 23 points down for a 108-102 victory Friday night over the New York Knicks, who finished 0-8 against the top two teams in the Eastern...
headlines.shortLinkText: Garland rallies Cavs to 108-102 win over No. 3 seed Knicks, who finish 0-8 vs East's top 2 teams

events.name: Cleveland Cavaliers at New York Knicks

headlines.description: — Julian Phillips scored a career-high 23 points on 7-of-9 shooting, Nikola Vucevic finished with 15 points, 12 rebounds and eight assists and the Chicago Bulls beat the Washington Wizards 119-89 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Julian Phillips scores a career-high 23 points and Bulls rout Wizards 119-89

headlines.description: — Bam Adebayo had 23 points and 12 rebounds in just 22 minutes, and the Miami Heat defeated reeling and injury-depleted New Orleans 153-104 on Friday night in what became the Pelicans' most lopsided regular-season loss in franchise history.
headlines.shortLinkText: Adebayo has 23 points and 12 rebounds as the Heat pound the Pelicans 153-104.

events.name: Miami Heat at New Orleans Pelicans

headlines.description: — Anthony Davis had 23 points, 13 rebounds and 10 assists for his fourth career triple-double, and the Dallas Mavericks beat the Toronto Raptors 124-102 on Friday night to snap a three-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Anthony Davis gets first triple-double of the season to lead Mavericks past Raptors 124-102

headlines.description: — Rudy Gobert matched his career high with 35 points and had 11 rebounds for Minnesota in a 117-91 victory over the Brooklyn Nets on Friday night that put the Timberwolves on the brink of a top-six...
headlines.shortLinkText: Timberwolves beat depleted Nets 117-91 behind Gobert's 35 points to close in on top-6 finish

headlines.description: — Nikola Jokic became the third player in NBA history to average a triple-double for a season, Jamal Murray...
headlines.shortLinkText: Jokic clinches triple-double average, Murray returns in the Nuggets' 117-109 win over the Grizzlies

headlines.description: — Aaron Wiggins scored 35 points and Isaiah Joe added 32 on a career-high 10 3-pointers to lead the Oklahoma City Thunder to a 145-111 victory over the Utah Jazz on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wiggins scores 35 points and Thunder roll over Jazz 145-111 for 31st road victory

events.name: Oklahoma City Thunder at Utah Jazz

headlines.description: — Ryan Dunn scored 26 points, Bradley Beal added 21 and the Phoenix Suns ended an eight-game losing streak with a 117-98 win over the San Antonio Spurs in their home finale on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan Dunn scores 26, Suns end 8-game losing streak with 117-98 win over Spurs in home finale

events.name: San Antonio Spurs at Phoenix Suns

headlines.description: — Jimmy Butler III scored 24 points and the Golden State Warriors routed the Portland Trail Blazers 103-86 on Friday night, but did not clinch a playoff spot with one game remaining.
headlines.shortLinkText: Butler scores 24 points to lead Warriors in 103-86 rout of Trail Blazers

events.name: Golden State Warriors at Portland Trail Blazers

headlines.description: - James Harden had 23 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists, Kawhi Leonard scored 28 points and the Los Angeles Clippers held off a late flurry in the final two minutes and beat the Sacramento Kings 101-100 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Clippers hold off Kings 101-100 to remain tied with Nuggets for No. 4 in tight Western Conference

headlines.description: — Luka Doncic had 39 points, eight rebounds and seven assists and the Los Angeles Lakers clinched the No. 3 seed in the Western Conference playoffs with a 140-109 victory over the Houston Rockets on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luka scores 39 points, Lakers wrap up Pacific title and No. 3 seed with win over resting Rockets

events.name: Houston Rockets at Los Angeles Lakers
